name: demo_small_c3: incubate
description: UNROUTED. Built by assay2chip/stages/s6_build.py from partition.json: ops 5 incubate, 6 wash -> serpentine_channel 'incubate_5'. mix, incubate, wash share one board; they run between 20 and 20 C; 5 of the 6 ports allowed at demo scale; 23% of the envelope 30 x 20 mm (demo envelope), ONE fluidic layer at ONE 0.3 mm etch depth, base and lid 3 / 1 mm. COP (cyclic olefin polymer, low-Tg grade 1060R) because hot_embossing route; 90 C max working temperature covers the 20 C hold. The hottest hold here is 20 C. SIZED FROM THE LOAD, never from the paper's tube volumes (assay2chip/README.md, 'Bench volumes do not transfer'): incubate_5 from 2,000 cells at 1500 per uL = 1.33 uL of suspension (the largest load of op(s) 5, 6: op 5). ONE PART PER PLACE (chip/designs/README.md rule 1): ops 5, 6 (incubate, wash) all act on the same cells in 'incubate_5', so they share one chamber sized for the largest of their loads and held at each temperature in turn. PLACEMENT: parts sit in flow order in 1 row(s) (left to right), spread across the usable 23.6 x 13.6 mm so the slack between them is routing corridor. Total chain length 37.2 mm, crossing risk 0, nothing rotated; every feature keeps at least 0.4 mm to its neighbours and to the chip edge. PORTS: 4 (inlet_1, outlet_1, reagent_in, waste), each over a PORT PAD the registry sized, so the bore opens entirely onto cut area and the port-overlap rule in tools/check_chip_spec.py passes. Inlets and outlets are on opposite edges, which is what keeps the layout planar in one layer, and no two ports are closer than 5 mm. CHANNELS BETWEEN PARTS ARE DELIBERATELY EMPTY: S7 routes them from assay2chip/work/<id>/connections_demo_small_c3.json. Until it has run, a chamber here is unconnected on purpose, and every rule that needs a channel - channel width against capsule diameter, channel crossings, protocol targets - can only be checked after S7. REALISED AS CHANNELS, not as parts: op(s) 4 (mix) - op(s) 4 (mix) carry a stream and nothing states a residence time, so there is no length or volume to build to; realised as the connecting channel rather than as a part. A conduit is sized from flow and residence time, and one that comes out smaller than a face a channel can attach to is not a small part but an unusable one, so it becomes the channel instead, lengthened to the length it needs. Parts sized by assay2chip/parts/registry.py. RISKS carried from sizing: this is a delay line, not a mixer: at Re << 1 folding adds residence time and nothing else (blocks.json herringbone_mixer is the mixing block).
